newsitem.title: USA: Ford gets 9,000 orders for Lincoln Navigator.
newsitem.headline: Ford gets 9,000 orders for Lincoln Navigator.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said Wednesday its Lincoln Mercury dealers have placed orders for more than 9,000 of its Lincoln Navigator sports utility vehicles.
The Navigator officially goes on sale at Lincoln dealerships on July 1.
Ford said demand has been so strong for the Navigator and its Ford Expedition that the company has dedicated the Michigan Truck Plant to producing full-size four-door utility vehicles.
The Michigan Truck Plant began producing the Ford Expedition last July. With Lincoln Navigator production, it has increased capacity to 282,000 vehicles a year.

Demand for the new Lincoln Navigator, along with continued strong orders for Expedition and F-Series pickups, has led to a 50,000 unit system-wide increase in truck production capacity this year, the company said.
